subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo + economic buyer / procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo + economic buyer / procurement path

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through the Redwood demo. Quick recap and a request to help us align the next steps so we can get a pilot on your calendar: 

Recap from our call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost by ~40% while keeping 95th percentile latency under 200ms for customer-facing chat.
- Decision criteria called out: latency/SLO, unit cost per 1k tokens, data governance (VPC/KMS), and procurement/contracting timeline.
- Pilot scope: 3 internal product teams, 2 weeks of production-like traffic to validate performance and billing.

What I need from you to move forward:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and the budget owner for this initiative?
2) Please loop in procurement/legal so we can share the procurement questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence early.
3) Proposed next step: 30–45 min intro with the economic buyer + procurement + our engineering lead (David Kim) next week to align on technical and contract requirements.

I attached a short MAP-outline (one pager) and a draft SOW to this thread to give your team visibility into timeline and milestones. If you prefer, I can send a lean one-page pricing summary instead.

My availability next week: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT, Thu 1–4 PT. If you'd rather propose times, that works too.

Thanks — looking forward to lining everyone up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: MAP-outline.pdf, SOW-Draft-v1.docx

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo + economic buyer / procurement path

Hi Marissa —

Great demo yesterday — appreciate the focused discussion. Quick answers and a couple of asks: 

1) Economic buyer: Daniel Cho (VP Product) — he owns the product budget for the teams you demoed for. I've CC'd him here.
2) Procurement: procurement@acme.com (I've looped them in). They'll want the standard questionnaire and SOC 2 Type II.
3) Timeline: we are aiming to select a vendor and kick a pilot by mid-Jan (target decision window is late Dec → early Jan).
4) Decision criteria (high level): total cost of ownership (unit cost per 1k tokens), ability to run in our VPC / customer-managed KMS, and an SLA that covers production latency.

Procurement asked that you send a completed procurement questionnaire and your SOC 2 report. They also requested an initial one-pager on pricing (not full list pricing, just order-of-magnitude for the pilot).

I've attached the procurement questionnaire they prefer we use — procurement@acme.com can confirm if they want it filled out on your side or if they will take our answers and consolidate.

Daniel — can you confirm that you're the right person for budget approval and if there are any additional stakeholders (Finance or Platform leadership) we should include?

Thanks,
Samantha
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com

Attachments: Acme_Procurement_Questionnaire.docx

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo + economic buyer / procurement path

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note. Please find attached our standard procurement questionnaire (filled) — we completed the sections we could and left placeholders for vendor-provided evidence (SOC reports, data flow diagrams, encryption at rest/in transit specifics).

What we need from Redwood to keep the procurement process moving:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest)
- Data flow diagram showing how customer data is handled in both hosted and private deployments
- High-level commercial terms (pilot pricing, standard T&Cs, SCCs if applicable)

Procurement lead: Jenna Park (copied on internal tracker) will coordinate the contract review. Our typical procurement timeline is 3–6 weeks once we have vendor evidence and draft terms.

Regards,
Acme Procurement
procurement@acme.com

Attachments: Acme_Procurement_Questionnaire_Filled.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo + economic buyer / procurement path

Hi Daniel / Jenna / team —

Thanks Samantha and Acme procurement for the quick responses and for sharing the completed questionnaire. Daniel — great to meet you (virtually). 

To keep momentum, proposed next steps from our side: 
- I'll share the SOC 2 Type II report and a simple data flow diagram that covers both Hosted and Private deployment patterns (attached).
- Lauren Bishop, our Customer Success lead (cc'd), will own the pilot success plan/MAP execution.
- David Kim, Solutions Engineer (cc'd), will be available for a technical sync to walk the data flow and answer any KV cache / latency questions.
- Proposed meeting: Thu 11/19 10:00–10:45 PT or Fri 11/20 9:00–9:45 PT — 30–45 min with Daniel + Procurement + our team. Please confirm a time or propose alternatives.
- I'll also send a short one-pager price estimate for the pilot by EOD today.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII.pdf, Redwood_Data_Flow_Diagram.png

If procurement prefers, we can prefill answers to the questionnaire and return a completed vendor copy. Let me know your preference.

Thanks all — looking forward to the intro meeting and aligning next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
